name: 06_open_refrigerator
title: Fetching Drink from Refrigerator
summary: The robot opens the refrigerator door, removes a bottle, closes the door, cleans the counter, and reopens the refrigerator.
robot: two robotic arms with black multi-jointed dexterous hands
setting: a kitchen corner with a bronze refrigerator next to a white table

source.original_prompt: Open the refrigerator door with the left arm

segments.instruction: Reach the right hand forward and hook the fingers into the side edge of the upper refrigerator door.
Pull the upper refrigerator door fully open with the right hand, showing the shelves inside.
Reach the left hand to the door rack, grasp the white bottle, and set it down onto the white table.
Push the refrigerator door closed with the right hand until it latches shut.
segments.memory_event: hide: refrigerator interior and remaining drinks hidden inside the closed fridge

segments.instruction: Turn the camera slightly left to focus on the white table and slide the white bottle further back.
Pick up the blue cloth resting on the counter corner and wipe the tabletop next to the bottle.
Turn the camera back toward the refrigerator and pull the upper door open again.
segments.memory_event: return: refrigerator interior with identical shelving and drink containers, with the white bottle missing from the door shelf

segments.instruction: Hold the door open and rest both hands in front of the shelves.
